title: Marlon Humphrey on Ja'Marr Chase: It would be cool if I didn't match up with him so much

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Marlon Humphrey on Ja'Marr Chase: It would be cool if I didn't match up with him so much
sources.description: Humphrey and Chase have faced off nine times. In those games, Chase has torched the Ravens for 77 catches for 1,245 yards and eight touchdowns.
